hooks.command: diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mcp/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mcp/package.json" . && (test -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mcp/package-lock.json" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mcp/package-lock.json" . || true) && npm install --omit=dev) || rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json"
